# keyrx

> Solana vanity address grinder. One seed, unlimited addresses, keys for every wallet. Offline. Open. Verified. The mark is a record. What it seals comes next.
>
> One seed phrase is a tree of addresses; keyrx
> derives the expensive prefix once and walks the account index - 20-60x the
> throughput of `solana-keygen grind --use-mnemonic`. Every match writes the
> address, its derivation path, the seed phrase, and the keypair in both
> wallet-import forms (base58 for Phantom, JSON byte array for Solflare and
> solana-keygen). One Rust binary. No daemon, no service, no network.

The site is a terminal UI rendered in JavaScript with a real toy grind in a
Web Worker; nothing leaves the browser. This file carries the same content
as plain text.

## Install

    cargo install keyrx && clear && keyrx    # or: git clone https://github.com/keyrx/keyrx && cargo install --path .
    keyrx verify                 # run first, always: base58, derivation, the pinned solana-keygen answer
    keyrx bench --indices 128    # this machine's real rate; estimate uses it
    keyrx grind --ends-with MINT --indices 128
    keyrx show MINT --keys       # base58 (Phantom) + JSON array (Solflare); seeds/keys withheld by default

## What a match writes

Five lines, in a mode-0600 file inside a mode-0700 directory of its own
(~/.local/share/keyrx/matches/, named after the pattern): address, path,
seed, privkey (base58 keypair), keypair (JSON byte array). A key import lands
on the exact address in one paste as a standalone account - the file IS the
backup. Importing the seed instead places the address inside a recoverable
HD wallet at the printed path; Phantom reaches account N by N "add account"
clicks (grind with --indices 8 for that), Solflare takes the path directly.

## Verified

SLIP-0010 identical to solana-keygen at both path styles (pinned as tests);
ground hits re-derive from their own seed; both key encodings round-trip
through `solana-keygen pubkey` to the same address; 50,000 pubkeys x 10
suffix lengths agree with the full base58 encoding. Bench 24.4x baseline at
128 indices, 32.2x at 256.

MIT. Import and verify the address before funding. Match files hold seed
phrases and keys - treat them like a key.
